task: P0 #3.5 Camera 3 Image / AI Input Diagnostic ONLY

capture_provenance.description: Existing Camera 3 localhost VLC MPEG-TS remux; compressed video stream-copy, no transcoding
capture_provenance.timestamp_semantics: Media PTS from the newly captured compressed stream plus decode wall-clock times. Exact camera exposure UTC and live-worker sequence for each passive decoded frame are unavailable; do not treat decoded_at as exposure timestamp.
capture_provenance.independent_decode_sync: FFmpeg fps_mode=passthrough: compare consecutive source frames without CFR duplication. Unreliable advertised frame-rate metadata is not used; cadence is derived from PTS.

SOURCE.live_source_changing: YES: 20 consecutive frames, 0/19 exact duplicate pairs; mean adjacent BGR difference 0.25074/255. Change includes scene/noise/OSD; this does not establish moving traffic.
SOURCE.visually_usable: Current daylight sample is usable for limited vehicle detection: three identifiable parked/edge-clipped cars. The archived night sample is not usable for reliable road/vehicle interpretation.

IMAGE_QUALITY.blurry: Archived night optical scene is severely blurred/veiled while embedded DVR text remains sharp. Current daylight image is much clearer, with residual softness on small distant cars.
IMAGE_QUALITY.overexposure_glare: Current wet-looking road has localized bright reflections: 1.397% gray>=245. Prior baseline night has only 0.108% very bright pixels, so global overexposure is not supported; the separate archived night frame shows diffuse headlight-like bloom. Lens/cover contamination, IR reflection, focus or night exposure processing are hypotheses, not diagnosed mechanisms.
IMAGE_QUALITY.contrast_sufficient: Current grayscale std 39.84 versus 17.69 in the archived night baseline. Current contrast supports the three observed detections; night scene contrast/detail is inadequate for that claim.
IMAGE_QUALITY.resolution_sufficient_for_angle: 944x1080 is sufficient for the three present cars in this short daylight sample. One green car is only about 80x74 pixels and a partly occluded blue car about 25x87 pixels; edge cropping/distance limit detail. No claim of distant/small/moving-object coverage, lane precision or general accuracy.

PIPELINE.preview_matches_ai_input: YES for scene identity; concurrent live JPEGs match closely. Exact production pre-inference frame identity is not observable read-only because the worker does not publish frame IDs/PTS with each JPEG and its input recorder is disabled. The saved ai-input files are the EXACT arrays tapped at YOLO preprocess in a separate production-config replay of the captured raw frames: all 20 have max pixel difference 0.
PIPELINE.cityeye_degradation: Small measured JPEG loss only: quality75 round-trip PSNR 40.53 dB. Independent FFmpeg/OpenCV decodes of identical encoded frames differ by at most 3 channel levels. No severe blur or wrong-scene conversion found in current sample. Cannot categorically exclude an intermittent historical fault without historical pre-JPEG bitstream.
PIPELINE.actual_capture_path: Existing VLC localhost H.264 MPEG-TS remux -> OpenCV FFmpeg decode -> BGR frame copies -> YOLO. Custom VLCI420FrameBuffer/I420-to-BGR callbacks are NOT active in this macOS worker. Source codec is yuv420p; codec chroma subsampling is distinct from executing that custom conversion.
PIPELINE.tensor_preprocessing: YOLO network tensor [1,3,960,864], standard aspect-preserving resize/letterbox and BGR->RGB/normalization. The diagnostic also saves the preprocessed tensor visualization.
PIPELINE.same_frame_limit: No worker restart, attach, config flag or live instrumentation. Replay preserves pixels/model/thresholds but processes every source frame; production normally skips frames to its AI cadence, so replay tracker IDs/state are not represented as the live worker IDs.

YOLO.vehicles_visible: YES: left silver car partly cut by image edge, upper green car, upper-right blue car partly occluded. No moving vehicle sequence established in the 1.56-second sample.
YOLO.detects_vehicles: YES: 3 car detections on each of 20 frames (60 frame-level detections, not 60 unique vehicles). Concurrent production metrics also report 3 vehicles and 3 tracks.
YOLO.low_confidence_pass: Separate supported predict(conf=0.01) run produced 26-40 candidate boxes/frame, including many weak/overlapping far-edge/clutter boxes. These are unverified candidates, not additional proven vehicles; production threshold remains 0.22.

TRACKING.detections_reach_bytetrack: YES: instrumented ByteTrack.update received all three post-detector boxes on all 20 frames and returned three tracks each time.
TRACKING.suppression: No detector box was lost to ByteTrack or the CityEye confidence filter in this sample. Standalone predict at 0.01 is separate; below-0.22 candidates are not production detections.
TRACKING.loss_location: No loss observed for the three production-threshold detections. This does not validate tracking of moving vehicles, crowded scenes or reconnect behavior.

layer_assessment_A_to_I.A_camera_dvr_source: SUPPORTED as the likely layer of the historical night-condition image-quality problem; camera versus DVR optics/exposure/processing cannot be separated with available night evidence.
layer_assessment_A_to_I.B_libvlc_decoding: NOT SUPPORTED: active VLC process remuxes, not decodes, and independent decoders preserve the current scene. A historical transport/remux issue is not exhaustively ruled out.
layer_assessment_A_to_I.C_custom_I420_RGB_BGR: NOT ACTIVE in the running capture path; no current channel/stride corruption observed. Independent decoded pixels closely agree.
layer_assessment_A_to_I.D_JPEG_publication: MINOR loss measured; no evidence that it causes the severe historical blur. The historical DVR text is sharp while the optical scene is diffuse.
layer_assessment_A_to_I.E_preview_pipeline: No wrong scene or severe added blur observed; nearest same-scene live preview interior MAE 1.53-1.61/255, with no exact shared-frame ID claim.
layer_assessment_A_to_I.F_AI_input_pipeline: No loss in isolated exact-input replay (0 pixel difference); live annotated images show the same scene and three detections. Direct running-worker input dump unavailable without instrumentation.
layer_assessment_A_to_I.G_YOLO_detection: Working for all three clearly identifiable sampled cars. General recall/night recall not validated.
layer_assessment_A_to_I.H_ByteTrack: No suppression observed in actual ByteTrack.update replay or concurrent live counts.
layer_assessment_A_to_I.I_lack_of_visible_vehicles: Not the explanation for current sample: three cars visible/detected. Physical vehicle presence in the old obscured night image cannot be determined.

root_cause.diagnosis: Evidence points to a condition-dependent night image-quality problem upstream of usable detection, not a persistent CityEye conversion/JPEG/ByteTrack failure. Current daylight images are clear enough to detect and track three cars. Exact reason for historical night haze cannot be proved from stored JPEGs alone.
supporting_evidence: Current 20 consecutive frames, no duplicates; H.264 bitstream decoded independently with max channel difference 3.
Current raw -> actual replay YOLO preprocess arrays: byte-identical for all 20 frames.
Production JPEG quality75 round-trip PSNR 40.53 dB and concurrent live preview/AI images match the scene.
Night interior Laplacian variance 0.882 vs daylight mean 78.181; night contrast 17.690 vs daylight 39.837; sharp embedded DVR text remains visible in the old frame.
All 60 production-threshold detector observations reached ByteTrack; three returned tracks/frame; live worker simultaneously reports three tracks.
not_established: No native DVR monitor capture from the historical bad night condition.
No exact historical raw/pre-JPEG frames or compressed night bitstream.
No moving-vehicle, event accuracy, legal direction or ROI validation.
root_cause.next_action: Capture the native DVR display and the read-only CityEye source stream simultaneously when the same bad night condition recurs; compare them before changing settings.
root_cause.hackathon_usable: Conditionally YES for daylight live-view and basic detection/tracking demonstration, based on three sampled parked/partial cars. NO claim of night reliability or event readiness; spatial rules remain CALIBRATION_REQUIRED.

model_configuration.mode: Isolated offline replay of captured consecutive source frames. Actual arrays at YOLO preprocess and ByteTrack.update are tapped in this process only; running production worker was not instrumented. Live inference skips source frames; replay here processes every one of the 20 frames, so tracker IDs/state are not claimed identical to the running worker.
model_configuration.tracker_config:
# CityEye tuning keeps valid small road users while preserving ByteTrack stability.
tracker_type: bytetrack
track_high_thresh: 0.22
track_low_thresh: 0.10
new_track_thresh: 0.22
track_buffer: 30
match_thresh: 0.80
fuse_score: true

No source/installed-library edit or worker hook. Capture client has closed. Temporary helper scripts removed at completion. Diagnostic images/JSON/encoded stream retained.
